title: Program attachment updated
description: Generated after updating program‑level attachment overrides via the `PATCH /v1/deposits/programs/{programId}/attachment` endpoint. The update applies to all inheriting accounts. Consumers should regard the emitted state as the authoritative program‑level configuration.

program_id.title: Program Identifier
program_id.description: Program identifier in the pismo platform.

product_id.title: Product Identifier
product_id.description: Deposit product identifier currently attached to the program. UUID v4 format.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: Timestamp of the override update. the value must be RFC3339-compliant.

interest_capitalization_mode.title: Interest Capitalization Mode
interest_capitalization_mode.description: Program-level capitalization mode inherited by attached accounts. Emitted at top level. `REINVEST` (default) or `PAYOUT`.

overrides.title: Attachment overrides
overrides.description: Contains the persisted per‑attachment overrides applied on top of the product defaults. The field is omitted when all overrides are cleared by the `PATCH` request. At program level, only `renewal_term` is permitted. `maturity_instructions` and penalties are not accepted by IBA‑API and therefore never included.

renewal_term_override.title: Renewal term override
renewal_term_override.description: Term applied on each rollover. The Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) event renders the normalized persisted form, consisting of `unit` and `value`.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: Time unit of the renewal term.

renewal_calendar_maturity_date.title: Renewal calendar maturity date
renewal_calendar_maturity_date.description: Returned only when the request uses the calendar format. Format = `YYYY-MM-DD`.
